answer: Clawback garden: every reward vests slowly, like marble steps laid one per epoch, and unvested POA stays at risk. If any later audit proves two identities share a controller, the whole unvested balance of both is burned, not just the next payout. A sybil farm must keep every clone's pending stream exposed for ~100 closes, so one leak at the wharf of withdrawal costs the attacker weeks of mining across all clones, while an honest single agent risks nothing.
